"''Wait. What shuttle?|Omega and [[Tech]]|}} '''Shuttle two''' was a [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttle]] stationed at the [[Imperial doonium refinery]] on the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] shortly after its occupation by the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[Assault shuttle|attack shuttle]] was stolen by the [[Twi'lek]] [[Hera Syndulla]] and the [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] in order to disable the [[cannon]]s at the refinery so that Omega's fellow members of the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] could attack the refinery; the attack was intended to distract Imperial forces away from the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Lessu City|Lessu]] to allow Hera's [[parent]]s, the freedom fighters [[Cham Syndulla|Cham]] and [[Eleni Syndulla|Eleni]], to be [[Rescue on Ryloth|rescued]]. After firing upon the refinery and shutting down its power, Hera and Omega rescued the [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P]], who had made a previous unsuccessful attempt to deactivate the defenses. Hera [[pilot]]ed the [[shuttle]] away from the refinery, allowing the Bad Batch's [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']] to launch an attack on the facility. Once the clones [[Hunter]] and [[Echo]] had rescued Cham, Eleni, and their [[Prison|imprisoned]] [[Free Ryloth Movement|supporters]], Hera and Omega followed the ''Marauder'' in shuttle two, and they regrouped on [[Ord Mantell]]. {{Ship-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Rescue on Ryloth (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/rescue-on-ryloth-episode-guide|text="Rescue on Ryloth" Episode Guide - The Bad Batch}} *{{Databank|rho-class-transport-shuttle|Rho-class transport shuttle}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=シャトル2 |ka=მაქო ორი }} [[Category:Captured starships]] [[Category:Rho-class transport shuttles]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Empire]]
